Carbon Trust (2018). Manufacturing: Introducing energy saving opportunities for business. Technology overview CTV059. Carbon Trust, London.

A 26-page Carbon Trust awareness overview for manufacturers (buildings, compressed air, motors and drives, process heating, cooling, energy management, action checklist). No technology-level parameters: only generic 'up to X%' saving claims and case-study GBP savings. Numbers it has: UK industry 2016 276 TWh and 82 Mt CO2 (17% of UK energy); space heating 11% of manufacturing energy (over 45% in some sub-sectors); steam generation and distribution savings 10-30%; ~10% of steam boiler heat lost through poor distribution insulation; poorly maintained boiler uses 10% more energy; 3 mm steam leak costs GBP 1,700/yr; compressed-air wastage savings up to 30%, idling compressor up to 40% of full-load power, up to 90% of compressor heat recoverable; VSD 20% speed reduction about 50% power, VSD saves up to 30% running costs; rewound motors 1-2% less efficient, replacing failed motors with high-efficiency models 5%; dryers up to 30% of site energy; tank lids cut losses over 50%, 50 mm insulation up to 90%; lighting controls 30-50%, LED up to 80%. Not the CTG033 dairy guide or ECG092; it is a sibling Carbon Trust publication and answers no to-get row.
